messages:
marta: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands — thanks for the great questions. I want to capture items that need owners and the two links we promised: recording + slides here https://redwood.company/ah/2026-03-22 and our internal planning doc https://confluence.redwood/company/ah-2026-03-22.
ajay: Appreciate it. Can we get a single-sentence TL;DR on EU Dedicated timing so I can tell a customer?
marta: TL;DR: EU Dedicated pilot goal = Q3; GA target = Q4, contingent on capacity validation. Will firm dates after infra pass in early May. @kevin to confirm.
kevin: Confirming Ill run infra validation tests and post a short schedule. ETA: May 6 for results.
sophie: Legal wants the Private onboarding checklist before we promise dates to customers. Short checklist would help.
marta: Good point. @kevin can you drop a 1-page checklist (network, KMS, audit log paths, certs) in private-deploy repo? Mark it "sales-ready".
kevin: Yep. Will add checklist + a minimal network topo diagram by next Tue.
daria: On Optimize: is batching + cache still the Q2 priority? Wed like the perf target numbers for evals.
marta: Yes. Daria, can you publish the perf targets (p95 latency, tokens/sec improvements) in the roadmap doc and link to the eval plan?
daria: Ill add the numbers and an expected % cost delta for typical chat/embedding flows within 2 weeks.
olivia: For customer-facing materials, we should publish sample unit-cost comparisons (chat vs embeddings) with recommended quant/batch settings.
marta: Agree. @olivia to own sample cost sheets + 2–3 anonymized customer examples. Due in 2 weeks.
jena: Small ask from Support: can we add the rollout canary thresholds and the observability dashboard links so CS can triage faster?
marta: Yes — short policy: 5% canary -> 24h monitor -> 25% -> 72h monitor -> GA. Auto-fallback triggers on >150% error-rate or sustained p50 latency >2x baseline. Kevin will add dashboards and exact metric IDs to the rollout playbook.
kevin: Claiming the playbook dashboard links task. Will include grafana panels and alert IDs. ETA: 1 week.
deploy-bot: Recording uploaded to storage: https://storage.redwood.company/ah/2026-03-22/recording.mp4
marta: Recap of actions (reply to claim or adjust):
- kevin: infra validation schedule for EU Dedicated (due May 6)
- kevin: private-deploy 1-page checklist + topology (due next Tue)
- kevin: rollout playbook dashboard links + metric IDs (due 1 week)
- daria: publish batching/cache perf targets and cost delta in roadmap (due 2 weeks)
- olivia: sample unit-cost sheets + 2-3 anonymized customer examples (due 2 weeks)

marta: If I missed any live-thread questions, paste them here and Ill add owners. Thanks all. :sparkles:
